category.description: A categorization of the seller's type of business. See our [merchant categories guide](https://docs.stripe.com/issuing/merchant-categories) for a list of possible values.

category_code.description: The merchant category code for the seller’s business

city.description: City where the seller is located

country.description: Country where the seller is located

network_id.description: Identifier assigned to the seller by the card network. Different card networks may assign different network_id fields to the same merchant.

postal_code.description: Postal code where the seller is located

state.description: State where the seller is located

tax_id.description: The seller's tax identification number. Currently populated for French merchants only.

terminal_id.description: An ID assigned by the seller to the location of the sale.

url.description: URL provided by the merchant on a 3DS request
